name: 19 circles in a disk
description: 19 circles packed in a disk of radius 5. The hexagonal lattice is the natural first guess, but the wall is curved, so a tight answer needs a search that moves shapes rather than only resizing them. The solution loaded by default is the best arrangement this lab's own local search finds, not a published one: no coordinate list is published for this instance, so the shipped score is a number to beat rather than a record.
